EWS BD-1 smooth classic distortion with Volume, Gain and Tone plus a boost switch for low-mid/gain emphasis.
Compact one-knob EWS drive derived from the Brute Drive concept, covering heavy crunch through fiery distortion.
Second-generation Little Brute Drive with low/high gain voicings, three-stage mid switch and selectable 9V/16V drive operation.
Compact Fuzzy Drive successor with Fuzzy Drive and Fat Fuzzy modes, higher gain and deeper or thicker fuzz character.

Updated four-transistor Muff-style fuzz based on the Rams Head era, adding mid boost and controllable feedback functions.

Broad-range Japanese overdrive covering crunch through brown-sound territory with switchable open and high-gain modes.
